sentences.en: Sami claimed that he had lived his life with integrity.
sentences.zh: 萨米声称他一生都坚守正直。

sentences.en: I have a high regard for the integrity of our mayor.
sentences.zh: 我对我们的市长的正直非常尊重。

sentences.en: In our society we find men of integrity along with crooks.
sentences.zh: 在我们社会中，我们可以找到正直的人和骗子。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：integr（完整）+ity（性质）→完整
